semiconductor_relevance: Medium — the company distributes factory automation and inspection equipment relevant to semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Shyan Sheng HiTech Co., Ltd. specializes in the distribution of factory automation machinery and components, focusing on high-tech production and inspection equipment for the semiconductor industry. They aim to enhance automation, reduce costs, and improve production efficiency for their clients.

regional_presence.Taiwan: The company has multiple branches in Taipei, Taoyuan, Hsingho, Taichung, and Kaohsiung.
